# THE MATCHER FAMILIES THIS FIXTURE CARRIES EVIDENCE FOR.
#
# One family name per line, matching the `what` field of an entry in
# assert-no-hardcoded-strings.mjs's SHOWN_TO_A_PERSON list. Blank lines and
# `#` lines are ignored.
#
# 🔴 WHY THIS FILE EXISTS, AND WHY IT IS NOT A CONSTANT IN THE GUARD.
# The guard's per-family evidence check iterates over SHOWN_TO_A_PERSON, so it
# can catch a family whose regex has STOPPED MATCHING — but it is structurally
# blind to a family DELETED from the list, because the loop then never asks
# about it. The total floor is blind too (58 of apps/subly's 71 hits are
# `Text(…)`, so losing the labelling family outright still clears 20 by a wide
# margin). Deleting a matcher was therefore invisible to both limbs.
#
# So the set is declared HERE, outside the file being audited, and the guard
# asserts an IDENTITY in both directions:
#   · a name here that no matcher provides  → a family was DELETED  → FAIL
#   · a matcher not named here              → a family was ADDED with no
#                                             evidence earned            → FAIL
# Neither direction can be satisfied by editing one file: a genuine change to
# the matcher list has to come with the fixture that proves the new list works.
# Same reason the test-coverage ratchet lives in a committed manifest rather
# than as a constant inside assert-guard-coverage.mjs.
Text(…)
a labelling parameter
a defaulted copy parameter
